comment: Exact Arch Linux cloud image for the remote provider KVM acceptance. PINNED to v20261015.611680 after an owner-authorized provenance verification and independent review (web-docs/docs/remote-provider-unit-test-plan.md, 'Image provenance'). The pin covers the image bytes and the arch-boxes signing identity only: it is not an operational security assessment. The harness refuses to execute while any field is null, and never substitutes a floating 'latest' URL. primary_key_fingerprint is the signing key's primary; signing_subkey_fingerprints are the subkeys approved to sign images (Arch's arch-boxes key signs with a subkey; this one expires 2027-05-28).
